[Effects]
The following will activate when the Ability used is Circle Snipe, High Circle Snipe, or Lethal Strikes:
Increases Ability effects by XL.
Increases ATK/MATK by 5% activates as a Blessing skill when Alice's Wonder Horn, White Rabbit's Top Hat, and White Rabbit's Outfit Gear pieces are equipped in the Main Slot.

[Activation]
When any Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
